notes: Liliana, Waker of the Dead, printed: '[+1]: Each player discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.' Three players. Seat 1 has no card in hand and seat 2 has exactly one; I discard my chosen card (the first word) and seat 2 its only card. Each opponent is judged on its own: seat 1 loses 3 life (20 -> 17), seat 2 loses none, and I lose none.
